comments.content: The advertised defaults are not applied to deserialized requests. Jackson constructs records through the three-argument canonical constructor, so omitted optional fields remain null; `apply` then rejects the request and returns null. Apply the zh/en defaults in a compact canonical constructor, or mark both fields as required.

Adding `sourceLanguage` removes the previous public `Request(String text, String targetLanguage)` constructor, breaking existing Java callers. Preserve that signature as an overload delegating to `this(text, LANGUAGE_CODE_ZH, targetLanguage)`.
